title: Ending a Victorian tenancy
description: Steps for giving notice and closing out a Victorian rental agreement after the 2025 reforms. Summarised from Consumer Affairs Victoria.

sources.title: Notice to vacate in rental properties
New changes to the rental laws

items.title: Confirm you have a valid reason: no-reason notices ended on 25 November 2025
Gather the evidence the reason needs
items.detail: For example a contract of sale or agent engagement, a building permit, or a witnessed statutory declaration.

items.title: Check the notice period
items.detail: 90 days for sale, moving in, renovation or demolition; 14 days for reasons such as 14 days' rent owing.

items.title: For a fixed term, set the termination date on or after the end date
Complete and sign the Victorian notice to vacate form, stating the reason and date
Deliver it by registered post, by hand, or by email if the renter agreed
Don't re-let for 6 months where the reason requires it
Complete the exit condition report within 10 days, giving the renter a chance to attend
Tell the renter in advance if you will claim on the bond
Make the bond claim or refund through RTBA online
